name: Black Opium
description: Black Opium is a rock'n'roll-inspired gourmand fragrance launched by YSL in 2014. It was a game-changer in women's perfumery, introducing the now-ubiquitous coffee note as a main accord. The addictive blend of coffee, vanilla, and white flowers creates an electrifying scent that perfectly captures youthful energy and nightlife glamour.
